notes.title: Returner 77 Steam Summer Sale!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32089923/34373b97f5c813954fa45361368291643d59188c.jpg[/img]

Happy Steam Summer Sale! Returner 77 is 25% off. If you've been waiting to buy Returner now is a good time! For about the price of a coffee you can try out the immersive space mystery - pop on your headphones and get your puzzle on.

We wanted to thank everyone who has bought the game so far and has been engaged on the community page - we love hearing your comments, good and bad, about the game. We look over all of your posts and take comments and opinions seriously. If you have a comment about the game and want to make sure we keep doing whatever it is you liked (or stop doing whatever you didn't like) make sure to post about it in the community page.

Fantastic, yes is working hard on something new for you all - and we're itching to be able to tell you more. Keep checking our community pages, there will be some exciting announcements very soon. 

Until then, enjoy your summer and get your game on! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update 1.10 is Now Live!
notes.content:
Based on your super helpful feedback, we've made some improvements to the game including:

-Fixing the achievement issue with The Den
-Fixed a bug in a puzzle in The River

Thank you for playing Returner 77. If you liked the game consider leaving us a review. If you didn't like it also leave a review so we know how to improve! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Returner 77 Has Released on Steam!
notes.content:
Are you ready to save humanity? Returner 77 is finally available on Steam!

Returner 77 is our first game but not the last. We aspire to make a cinematic games you can lose yourself in, with crystalline environments and dynamic soundtracks. 

We value your feedback and activity in the community and we'll make sure to take your comments into consideration for future games. Share your experience of the game with your fellow players and please let us know what you think! If you liked the game a good review helps fuel us towards our next games.
